baseline.desc: Production tox model: reg:squarederror on viability; ChemBERTa384 + MolGpKa-PCA64 + handcrafted; GKDE weights. The reference for all A/Bs.

binary_clf.desc: Native binary:logistic P(toxic) head, same features/weights. Worklog: better in-distribution but WORSE OOD than regression; reconfirm on this split.

smote_r0.3.desc: SMOTE minority(toxic) oversampling in feature space to ratio 0.3, regression arm. Interpolates X and viability among toxic rows.

smote_clf_r0.5.desc: SMOTE to 0.5 on the binary classifier arm.

spw_3.desc: Binary clf with scale_pos_weight=3 (native XGB imbalance lever).

spw_8.desc: Binary clf with scale_pos_weight=8 (~inverse base rate 1/0.075≈13, softened).

smiles_aug3.desc: Randomized-SMILES augmentation: 3 non-canonical rewrites per train molecule (same label/features, different ChemBERTa token order). SMILES enumeration.

smiles_tta3.desc: Randomized-SMILES train aug + test-time augmentation (avg prediction over 3 randomized SMILES at inference).

rdkit_feats.desc: Add RDKit physchem descriptor block (logP/TPSA/HBD/HBA/...). Worklog: null OOD; reconfirm under the multi-seed pooled harness.

tabular_only.desc: Drop ChemBERTa + MolGpKa; handcrafted tabular features only. Worklog: tabular ≈ full stack OOD. Tests whether embeddings add anything.

cbpca128.desc: Denoise ChemBERTa 384->128 via train-only PCA before XGB.

focal.desc: Focal-R regression objective (down-weights easy non-toxic mass). Worklog: null; reconfirm.

logit_target.desc: Regress logit(viability) instead of raw viability (stretches the 0.7-0.9 toxic boundary region, compresses the dense ~1.0 mass).

no_gkde.desc: Ablate ALL sample weighting (drop baked GKDE×Experiment_weight -> uniform). Seed-0 probe suggested GKDE tail-upweighting hurts OOD toxic detection.

logit_uniform.desc: Combine the two best round-1 levers: logit target + uniform weights.

upw2.desc: Multiply toxic-row (viability<0.8) weights ×2 on top of GKDE (clean imbalance lever, no synthetic pts).

upw3.desc: Toxic-row weight ×3 on top of GKDE.

upw5.desc: Toxic-row weight ×5 on top of GKDE.

depth3.desc: Shallower trees (max_depth 6->3) to reduce overfit on the sparse toxic signal.

molgpka_pca16.desc: Shrink MolGpKa PCA 64->16 (less overfit from the charge-embedding block).

drop_molgpka.desc: ChemBERTa + handcrafted only (isolate the MolGpKa block's OOD value).

uniform_depth3.desc: Uniform weights + shallow trees (stack the two most promising levers).

logit_rdkit.desc: Logit target + RDKit physchem descriptor block.

molgpka_pca8.desc: MolGpKa PCA 8 (even tighter than the winning 16).

mgk16_strongreg.desc: Winner + stronger XGB regularization (stack two regularizers).

baseline_v8.desc: VERIFY: baseline (MolGpKa PCA64) at 8 seeds — matched reference.

molgpka_pca16_v8.desc: VERIFY: the champion at 8 seeds — is the +0.08 real or 3-seed luck?

pka_nomolgpka.desc: ChemBERTa + handcrafted + pKa scalars, NO MolGpKa embedding (replace the 1024d charge embedding with just its 4 mechanistic pKa scalars).

mono_dose.desc: Baseline + monotonic dose constraints (viability non-increasing in lipid/NA dose).

mgk16_pka_mono.desc: Stack all mechanistic priors: MolGpKa16 + pKa scalars + monotone dose.

mgk64_transfer.desc: MolGpKa PCA-64 basis fit on delivery corpus (does transfer rescue the full-dim block?).

cbpca128_transfer.desc: ChemBERTa PCA-128 basis fit on delivery corpus (in-domain cbpca128 was null; does transfer help?).

mgk16_cbpca64_transfer.desc: Both blocks reduced with delivery-fit bases.

ts_mgk16_dropcharge.desc: Two-stage mgk16, drop only the 3 charge features.

base_dropweak.desc: Baseline (reg, full MolGpKa) minus the 5 weak features (isolate pruning effect).

ts_mgk16_logit.desc: Two-stage mgk16 with logit-target regressor arm.
